name: Say No to Mirror Daddy
source:
He will not guilt trip, he will not pressure, beg or force, he will only simply ask and all you have to do to save your soul is say no~ Easy peasy!

Say No To Mirror Daddy is a cautionary tale about the dangers of sleeping with an uncovered mirror in front of your bed.

[From [url=https://sky-artdesigns.itch.io/say-no-to-mirror-daddy]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
他不会内疚，他不会压力，乞求或强迫，他只会简单地要求，而你所要做的就是说“不”来拯救你的灵魂~ Easy peasy！

《对镜子爸爸说不》是一个警示故事，讲述了在床前放着未遮盖的镜子睡觉的危险。

[来自[url=https://sky-artdesigns.itch.io/say-no-to-mirror-daddy]itch.io[/url]]
